segments.text: Granddaughters, Happy Friday! Bitcoin and the entire market were a bit down, but now they've turned up the heat and touched $79,000 again. It's time to go higher. A stamp appeared at 67, inactive for now, but still there. The team is working hard, so come by sometimes to fish, boost our squad, and complete the "Sleeping Business" quest. 💰BTC $78,725 🔹ETH $2,608 (!) 🪙TON $1.37
